title: To Miss Butler
date: '1876-10-02'
display-date: Oct 2nd [1876 or earlier[[footnote:1]]]
from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
from-address: Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.
to-name: To Miss Butler
manuscript-location: MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
---

My dear Miss Butler[^2]
It is very kind of you and Mrs Butler but I believe [Miss Mackenzie ](/person/930)is likely to come to me immediately after Lownie’s visit, and as there have been some difficulties about her coming before I could not put it off again.

This is a hurried day so I must only write my thanks

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Evidently before the death of Anne Mackenzie in February 1877.
[^2]: This letter may be addressed to [Anna Butler](/person/237), the sister of CMY\'s friend the Rev.

William Butler, Vicar of Wantage.
